goal: Publish v1.6.0 with a durable loop-engine evaluation and explicit embedded-project-loop recommendation.

primary_metric.name: passing_forward_contract_cases
primary_metric.threshold: 11 of 11 cases pass and all package gates pass

hard_constraints: Preserve v1.5.0 baseline and existing custom conventions.
Keep physical and semantic model-level proof separate.
Do not force-push or rewrite existing tags.

results: 10 forward cases and prior package gates pass
11/11 forward cases; 28 skills; 9 board profiles; all deterministic package gates pass; release refs verified

per_iteration_budget: one cohesive repository patch followed by targeted validation
evaluation_method: repository validators plus positive and negative loop fixtures
acceptance_rule: keep only if 11/11 cases and all package gates pass
rollback_method: restore only this release experiment surface before commit; preserve unrelated worktree changes
plateau_rule: stop after two consecutive repair cycles without a passing improvement
open_uncertainties: Model-level trigger behavior is not exercised by the deterministic harness.
Physical and deployment evidence remains user-owned.
